shipped_rows.title_o: A controlled experiment in maintenance: comparing design patterns to simpler solutions

blind_target.evidence_quote: An article published in 2001 reported a controlled experiment that compared maintenance of small programs using design patterns with maintenance of equivalent programs using simplified design solutions. A replication of that experiment was published in 2004. In 2010, a group of researchers from multiple countries picked this experiment as the subject of an attempt to perform a joint replication: Many groups performing an experiment using the same setup, each contributing a few data points to a larger overall data set. This article reports on one of those sub-replications.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Only one of the results is statistically significant; it confirms the result of the original experiment stating that the simplified version of the GR program could be extended more quickly than the pattern version which used the Abstract Factory and Composite patterns.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The only explicit original-result comparison in the available abstract confirms the original. Other nonsignificant results are not explicitly compared, so the broader outcome remains uncertain.

luna_triage.reason: The source abstract identifies the joint replication as testing the 2001 controlled experiment and reports its result about the simplified GR program being extended more quickly. The supplied shipped row 903 is Prechelt et al.’s 2001 controlled experiment on design patterns versus simpler maintenance solutions, matching that original despite the source abstract omitting its author citation and title.
